apply: if [ "$INGLENOOK_VARIANT" = day ]; then bg=light; else bg=dark; fi; printf "vim.o.background = '%s'\nvim.cmd.colorscheme('inglenook')\n" "$bg" > ~/.config/nvim/init.lua
stage: p=/org/gnome/terminal/legacy/profiles:/:$(gsettings get org.gnome.Terminal.ProfilesList default | tr -d "'")/; dconf write ${p}use-system-font false; dconf write ${p}font "'BlexMono Nerd Font Mono 13'"; dconf write ${p}scrollbar-policy "'never'"
